Strategy: Third-gap pairing preference. Score each bin by how close its residual is to a third of the item, preferring a gap that could hold a small item. The choice differs from Best Fit whenever the tightest fit leaves a residual far from a third of the item while a looser bin leaves a gap near it. It may help by creating reusable small gaps, but may fail if future items are not about a third this size.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-abs(r - item - item / 3) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Third-gap pairing preference: post-placement residual closest to item/3 wins.
